label: monty-hall
title: A game of Monty Hall whose winning door nobody knows
summary: The client-held sidecar example. The network draws a seed nobody knows and derives the winning door from it, as parts. Between rounds the game state exists only as a state record, one sealed third per node, that the player carries. She requests every round; the host lands the seed and the start of the game, and she lands the rest from her own wallet, each private function verifying the round's co-SNARK proof under a vk hash pinned in a note. The contract has no public functions and no public state, so nothing crosses the divide and the relayer is idle.

steps.title: The host registers the four circuits
steps.text: The [[host]] signs a REGISTER body with the namespace owner key: the four circuits and their manifests, under the address of the contract it just deployed ([[ho-deploy|the deploy]]). Each node checks every circuit against its manifest, computes its vk hash, and runs the registration circuit, which derives the namespace's nullifier secret `nsk_app` from the master secret as parts. Nobody holds `nsk_app` whole. The nodes answer with the vk hashes and `npk_app_hash`, which the contract will pin; the host tells the [[player]] the address and the pins.

steps.title: The nodes prove pss_seed
steps.text: The three nodes run [[pss_seed]] together. They sample the seed and its blinding as parts, so nobody knows the seed, and output its note hash. Each node seals its third of the stored seed to itself, signs its result and keeps the row. The [[orch]] checks the three agree and answers the [[player]] with the proof, the effects and the seed record.

steps.title: The nodes prove monty_hall_open_door
steps.text: Each node opens its third of game record 0. Together they run [[monty_hall_open_door]]: spend game state 0, check her door is 0, 1 or 2 on parts, and open a door that is neither hers nor the winner. Her door 1 is not the winning door 0, so they open the third door, 2. They output the opened door and the commitment to the door they played, and store game state 1. The [[player]] gets game record 1, which replaces record 0.

steps.title: The player lands the round: open_door
